# Opening filings contract fixtures

- `openingFilings.browser.json`: anonymized response supplied from the failing browser GET (HTTP 200, application/json). Retains all six structures, property names, nulls, numeric measurements (including 2e-13), technical flags and the System modification with its string `evidence`. Identifiers, subject, project/SG and business descriptions were replaced with synthetic data; no operational credentials or customer data are included. Historical status remains LEGACY_INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE with canModify=false.
- `openingFilings.dto.json`: serialized directly with System.Text.Json / JsonSerializerDefaults.Web from the backend's compiled OpeningFilingsView, OpeningFilingView, OpeningFilingSource, MeasurementStructureView, InstallationComparison and InstallationModification records using synthetic data. Backend revision: de7958d. Includes an editable incremental filing and a blocked historical DTO with nullable comparison fields. No database was accessed.

The browser reproduction failed on 750a956 in sourceValid: its exact modification key list omitted `evidence`. The control with modification=null passed. The DTO reproduction additionally exercises nullable comparison values; these nulls are not the cause of the supplied browser failure. Root, filing and version DTO shapes otherwise match; neither fixture changes historical authorization or completeness.
